prose: The InnerVersal mystics of Marvel return to integrate the shadow of the Dark Mother Goddess & the Man of Light, with an incredibly deep analysis of Dr. Strange and the Multiverse of Madness. Rife with Gnostic Christian allegory and a psychologically shattered-mirror perspective on the All-Mother, this film may just be the wildest thing we've covered yet.
The Marvelous Demystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), Gordan Hamil.
